title: Prehistoric Times
content: If you're interested in dinosaurs (and other extinct creatures) you'll love the magazinePrehistoric Times, which for over a decade has covered the intersection between science, art, film, and collecting. Now published in full color, it presents interviews with artists and paleontologists, dino drawing tips, book reviews, and round-ups of recent discoveries. It's also a good venue for emerging paleoartists to showcase their work.-----Prehistoric Timeswebsite.
